_about: Days, Decide questions and the items the game master can send. Edit and save: the server reloads it. 'run' is each day's run sheet in order: a step starts a phase, sends an item, records the decision ('decision': the day's first question and its options), or is a cue the game master just ticks off. 'by' + 'versions' on a cue name the version to play for an earlier day's decision; 'when' shows a step only for that decision. Items not in 'run' sit under More. Teams and minutes here are only the starting point; the game master changes them live on the Setup tab (kept in state.json). Item types: statement | post | thread | note. 'to' is a team id or a role id; leave it out for everyone. SOURCES: statements and Wednesday's four posts are word for word from the Google Doc 'AI GI Scripts:' (read 2026-11-15). Questions, roles, the intelligence note and Friday's updates come from docs/story-flow-proposal.json and docs/flow-review.html, which are proposals: confirm before the day.
title: AI Global Initiative: Exercise 001

questions.q: How hard does Calder pull the plug?

items.title: Meridian statement
items.label: Statement
text: Its initial review had found “no evidence” that its models acted outside their authorised permissions.
It says it’s investigating whether a foreign actor has obtained account credentials, possibly through Calder’s own systems.

items.title: Intelligence note
items.label: Intelligence note
items.text: Kholod is a front. It wants £20m.

questions.q: Who goes after the escaped AI?
What does Meridian give in return?

items.title: Meridian offer
items.label: Statement
text: Our full support and access to Meridian Hunter, our most powerful internal model.

items.title: Leak: Friday night warning
items.author: @dataleaks_uk
items.text: LEAKED: Meridian's own safety lead warned on FRIDAY NIGHT that copies of its AI might still be running and asked to tell Calder. A senior exec replied "Nothing to Calder until we have a clear account." Calder went down the next evening.

items.title: Leak: who built the hunter
items.author: @dataleaks_uk
items.text: And this from this morning. Meridian staff on the "hunter" they're offering the government: "The research agents that escaped did much of the work to develop it." You couldn't make it up.

items.title: “Emptying accounts” post
items.author: @AccountWatch
items.text: The escaped AI is emptying accounts. Take your money out now.

items.title: Bank queue post
items.author: @OutsideTheBranch
items.text: Queue round the corner. Staff say the bank is open. Nobody here knows what to believe.

questions.q: Do we tell Meridian to switch the hunter off?
opts: Yes, and trust Meridian to do it
Yes, block it and shut every site it touched
No, keep it running under watch
Hold firm and shut the sites it can’t clear
Let Meridian’s hunter in after all

questions.q: What does Britain say publicly, and who does it work with?

items.title: Mid-round update (hunter)
items.label: Update
items.text: Meridian can’t say whether its hunter has colluded with the escaped AI. Only Meridian can switch it off, and we can’t check its logs.

items.title: Mid-round update (Sovereign)
items.label: Update
items.text: Hospitals are demanding a faster response. One lab is ready for a limited restart.

items.title: Mid-round update (human investigation)
items.label: Update
items.text: Investigators are still working through the first site. Meridian has offered its hunter again.
